options.name: delim
options.description: Delimiter to be used instead of V(" ") (space). Only used when O(state=value_present) or O(state=value_absent).

options.name: jail
options.description: Name or ID of the jail to operate on.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of variable in C(/etc/rc.conf) to manage.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to file to use instead of V(/etc/rc.conf).

options.name: state
options.description: Use V(present) to add the variable. Use V(absent) to remove the variable. Use V(value_present) to add the value to the existing variable. Use V(value_absent) to remove the value from the existing variable.

options.name: value
options.description: The value to set when O(state=present). The value to add when O(state=value_present). The value to remove when O(state=value_absent).
